summary: 2026 NHLR-registered Aermotor LS-40 tower in Sevier County, Tennessee, administered by the TN Division of Forestry and also listed as Bluff Mountain. No build or staffing history found.

facts.agency: TN Department of Agriculture - Division of Forestry

events.note: Registered June 28, 2026 as US 1831, TN 75; nominated by Jason Johns

evidence.supports: administered by TN Department of Agriculture, Division of Forestry
evidence.quote: TN Department of Agriculture - Division of Forestry
The tower is a 47ft tall Aermotor, model LS-40.

evidence.supports: named Bluff Mountain Fire Tower in map data
listed as Bluff Mountain in Sevier County

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The Register calls it Green Top; the map data and the Tennessee list call it Bluff Mountain. The Register coordinates match the brief's coordinates, so one tower is assumed. The OSM way was not checked against coordinates in the fetched text.
The Register gives 2,981 ft (909 m) for the site; the Tennessee list gives 3069 ft for Bluff Mountain. The sources do not say what each figure measures, so the Register figure is used.

notes_for_editor: Thin record. The NHLR entry is the only source with design or registry details, and it has no build, staffing or history. OSM and the Tennessee list support the Bluff Mountain name and the standing status, and the list gives 3069 ft; neither gives build or staffing history. Two web searches found no history specific to this tower; one returned a travel listing that says the tower is open for climbing, but it was not fetched, so it is not used. A different Bluff Mountain tower in Virginia (US Forest Service, c. 1917) appears in search results and should not be mixed in. Access, staffing, and build date are left out of facts because no fetched source supports them. No photos added. Not verified: whether the tower has changed since the 2026 Register entry.
